requirements.subject: iiRDS package
requirements.sentence: An iiRDS package MUST implement an iiRDS ZIP archive.
requirements.context: An iiRDS package is a bundle of information units including content and metadata for delivery from an iiRDS Generator to an iiRDS Consumer. An iiRDS package MUST implement an iiRDS ZIP archive.

requirements.subject: iiRDS container
requirements.sentence: An iiRDS container MUST have a single root directory.
requirements.context: An iiRDS container MUST have a single root directory.

requirements.sentence: An iiRDS container MUST have a directory META-INF.
requirements.context: An iiRDS container MUST have a directory META-INF. The directory is exclusively used for metadata on the iiRDS package and its contents.

requirements.sentence: The META-INF directory MUST contain the file metadata.rdf containing all metadata in RDF 1.1 XML syntax (see [rdf-syntax-grammar]).
requirements.context: The META-INF directory MUST contain the file metadata.rdf containing all metadata in RDF 1.1 XML syntax (see [rdf-syntax-grammar]).

requirements.sentence: If metadata is provided in the JSON-LD 1.1 syntax, the META-INF directory MUST contain the file metadata.jsonld (see [json-ld11]).
requirements.context: If metadata is provided in the JSON-LD 1.1 syntax, the META-INF directory MUST contain the file metadata.jsonld (see [json-ld11]). The file metadata.jsonld is optional in unrestricted iiRDS, but mandatory for iiRDS/H packages.

requirements.sentence: When both metadata.rdf and metadata.jsonld exist in an iiRDS package, the content of the files MUST semantically match and be consistent with each other.
requirements.context: When both metadata.rdf and metadata.jsonld exist in an iiRDS package, the content of the files MUST semantically match and be consistent with each other.
